hook_line: COSMOSERVE RAISES $6 MILLION TO REMOVE SPACE DEBRIS, OPENS HYDERABAD FACILITY

hook_stat.sub: Seed round led by Japan's Rebright Partners

stats.label: Cosmoserve targets starting commercial operations by 2028
Target for completing all technology demonstrations
How close a full-scale demonstration aims to approach a dead satellite

diaspora_bullets: Base 1 in Hyderabad is India's first private space debris removal facility
Its craft are designed to be refuelled in orbit so one mission can remove multiple pieces of debris
news_summary: Hyderabad spacetech startup Cosmoserve Space has raised $6 million in a seed round led by Japan's Rebright Partners, taking its total funding past $9 million since it was founded last year.
payoff: Cosmoserve targets completing all technology demonstrations by 2027 and starting commercial operations by 2028.
